condition.yoga_name: Raja Yoga — Framework

yoga_check.description: Meta-framework rule. Requires identifying Atmakaraka (highest degree planet), computing Karakamsa Lagna (Navamsa sign of Atmakaraka), and evaluating Chara Karaka scheme — all Jaimini concepts outside current engine scope.

interpretation.brief: Framework rule — determines which planetary pairs and reference points to use when assessing the strength and maturity o
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: Raja Yogas are to be evaluated from two reference points: (1) the Karakamsa Lagna (Navamsa sign of the Atmakaraka) and (2) the natal ascendant. From the Karakamsa reference, the Atmakaraka and Putrakaraka (Chara Karaka, 6th in the Karakamsa scheme) are the key planets. From the natal ascendant, the ascendant lord and 5th lord are the key planets. The 5th lord is equated in importance to the 9th lord for Raja Yoga analysis. Effects are full, half, or quarter according to the strength of the participating planets.

Effect: Framework rule — determines which planetary pairs and reference points to use when assessing the strength and maturity of any Raja Yoga in the horoscope.

condition.yoga_name: Maha Raja Yoga

yoga_check.description: Condition A requires identifying Asc lord and 5th lord and verifying sign exchange (Parivartana) — lord identification required. Condition B requires Atmakaraka identification (highest-degree planet), Chara Putrakaraka, and Navamsa dignity check — Jaimini + divisional chart required.

interpretation.brief: The native will be famous and happy. Considered the supreme Raja Yoga — bestows the highest status and recognition.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: Condition A: Ascendant lord and 5th lord exchange their signs (Parivartana Yoga between houses 1 and 5). Condition B: Atmakaraka and Putrakaraka (Chara Karaka) are together in the natal ascendant or 5th house (or Karakamsa Lagna and 5th therefrom), OR separately in their exaltation/own/own Navamsa signs and aspected by a natural benefic.

Effect: The native will be famous and happy. Considered the supreme Raja Yoga — bestows the highest status and recognition.

condition.yoga_name: Atmakaraka-Ascendant Lord Raja Yoga

yoga_check.description: Requires identifying Atmakaraka (highest-degree planet among Sun through Saturn) and Asc lord. Atmakaraka is a Jaimini concept outside current engine scope.

interpretation.brief: A Raja yoga is formed; the native attains high status.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: The natal ascendant lord and the Atmakaraka are conjunct in the ascendant, 5th, or 7th house, with a natural benefic in conjunction with or aspecting them. If the ascendant lord himself is the Atmakaraka, his placement in the 1st, 5th, or 7th with a benefic suffices.

Effect: A Raja yoga is formed; the native attains high status.

condition.yoga_name: Benefics from Atmakaraka / Ascendant Lord Raja Yoga

yoga_check.description: Houses 2/4/5 are counted from the ascendant lord's sign (not from Lagna) and from Atmakaraka's sign — both require lord identification and Jaimini Atmakaraka computation.

interpretation.brief: The native will become a king.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: Natural benefics occupy the 2nd, 4th, and 5th houses counted from the natal ascendant lord's sign position OR from the Atmakaraka's sign position.

Effect: The native will become a king.

condition.yoga_name: Malefics from Atmakaraka / Ascendant Lord Raja Yoga

yoga_check.description: 3rd and 6th counted from Asc lord's sign and Atmakaraka sign — requires lord identification + Jaimini Atmakaraka.

interpretation.brief: The native will become a king.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: Natural malefics occupy the 3rd and 6th houses counted from the natal ascendant lord's sign position OR from the Atmakaraka's sign position.

Effect: The native will become a king.

condition.yoga_name: Venus in Karakamsa — Royal Association Yoga

yoga_check.description: Karakamsa Lagna (Navamsa sign of Atmakaraka) and Arudha Pada (Pada for the Lagna) are both Jaimini concepts requiring divisional chart computation and special ascendant derivation.

interpretation.brief: The native will be related to royal circles.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: Venus occupies one of four positions: the Karakamsa Lagna, the 5th from Karakamsa Lagna, the natal ascendant, or the Arudha (Pada) ascendant — AND is in aspect to or conjunction with Jupiter or the Moon.

Effect: The native will be related to royal circles.

condition.yoga_name: Single Planet Aspects Special Lagna — Raja Yoga

yoga_check.description: Hora Lagna and Ghatika Lagna are time-based special ascendants (derived from birth time, sunrise, and duration of day) outside current Rasi-chart scope. Aspect detection also required.

interpretation.brief: The native will become a king.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: Even a single planet aspects any one of the three special ascendants: the natal ascendant (Lagna), Hora Lagna, or Ghatika Lagna.

Effect: The native will become a king.

condition.yoga_name: Shadvarga Lagna Raja Yoga

yoga_check.description: Requires computation of 6 separate divisional chart ascendants (D-1 through D-12) and aspect evaluation across all six — far beyond current Rasi-only engine scope.

interpretation.brief: A Raja yoga is doubtlessly formed.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: The six divisional ascendants (Shadvarga: Rasi, Hora, Drekkana, Trimsamsa, Navamsa, and Dvadasamsa) are all occupied or aspected by one and the same planet. The yoga is full/medium/negligible according to whether the planet's aspect is full/half/quarter.

Effect: A Raja yoga is doubtlessly formed.

condition.yoga_name: Three Ascendants Exalted — Raja Yoga (A)

yoga_check.description: Hora Lagna and Ghatika Lagna are time-based special ascendants outside current scope. Exaltation/own sign check (dignity) also required.

interpretation.brief: A Raja yoga is formed.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: The natal ascendant, Hora Lagna, and Ghatika Lagna are each occupied by a planet in exaltation or in its own sign.

Effect: A Raja yoga is formed.

condition.yoga_name: Three Ascendants Exalted — Raja Yoga (B)

yoga_check.description: Requires computing Drekkana (D-3) and Navamsa (D-9) ascendants and checking dignity in those divisional charts.

interpretation.brief: A Raja yoga is formed.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: The natal ascendant, the Drekkana ascendant (ascendant of the Drekkana/D-3 chart), and the Navamsa ascendant (ascendant of the D-9 chart) are all occupied by exalted planets.

Effect: A Raja yoga is formed.

condition.yoga_name: Arudha Lagna Moon-Jupiter Raja Yoga

yoga_check.description: Arudha Lagna (Pada of the 1st house) is a Jaimini concept requiring special derivation. Dignity and aspect checks additionally required.

interpretation.brief: A Raja yoga is formed.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: The Moon and a natural benefic are conjunct in the Arudha Lagna (Pada of the natal ascendant), Jupiter is in the 2nd house from the natal ascendant, and both the Arudha Lagna position and the 2nd house are aspected by planets in exaltation or in their own signs.

Effect: A Raja yoga is formed.

condition.yoga_name: Benefics in 1-2-4, Malefic in 3 — Raja Yoga

yoga_check.description: Benefics in houses 1, 2, and 4 AND malefic in house 3. All conditions evaluated from natal ascendant. Pure planet-position check — no lord or dignity lookup required.

interpretation.brief: The native will become a king or equal to a king.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: Natural benefics occupy the ascendant (1st), 2nd, and 4th houses while a natural malefic is placed in the 3rd house.

Effect: The native will become a king or equal to a king.

condition.yoga_name: Benefic Exalted in 2nd — Wealth Yoga

yoga_check.description: Requires checking whether the planet in house 2 is in its exaltation sign — dignity check needed (Moon exalted in Taurus, Jupiter in Cancer, Venus in Pisces, Mercury in Virgo). Phase 2: new type 'planet_exalted_in_house' with house=2, planets=[Moon, Jupiter, Venus, Mercury].

interpretation.brief: The native will be wealthy.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: One among the Moon, Jupiter, Venus, or Mercury is placed in the 2nd house in its exaltation sign.

Effect: The native will be wealthy.

condition.yoga_name: Debilitated Planets in 6-8-3, Exalted Asc Lord — Raja Yoga

yoga_check.description: Requires identifying Asc lord + checking its dignity (exaltation/own sign) + aspect to Lagna. Debilitation in specific houses also requires dignity check per planet.

interpretation.brief: A Raja yoga is formed.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: Debilitated (neecha) planets occupy the 6th, 8th, and 3rd houses while the ascendant lord is in exaltation or in his other own sign and aspects the natal ascendant.

Effect: A Raja yoga is formed.

condition.yoga_name: 6-8-12 Lords Afflicted, Asc Lord Strong — Raja Yoga

yoga_check.description: Requires identifying lords of houses 6, 8, 12, and the Asc lord. Dignity checks for debilitation/inimical/combustion and own/exalt required for all four lords.

interpretation.brief: A Raja yoga is formed.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: The lords of the 6th, 8th, and 12th houses are in debilitation (fall), inimical signs, or combustion, while the ascendant lord is in his own sign or exaltation sign and aspects the natal ascendant.

Effect: A Raja yoga is formed.

condition.yoga_name: 10th Lord Own-Exalt Aspects Lagna — Raja Yoga

yoga_check.description: Requires identifying the 10th lord, verifying its dignity (own/exalt sign), and checking its aspect to the Lagna.

interpretation.brief: A Raja yoga is formed.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: The 10th lord is placed in his own sign or exaltation sign and aspects the natal ascendant.

Effect: A Raja yoga is formed.

condition.yoga_name: Benefics in Angles — Raja Yoga

yoga_check.description: Natural benefics in the four angular (kendra) houses from the natal ascendant. Pure positional check.

interpretation.brief: A Raja yoga is formed.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: Natural benefics (Jupiter, Venus, Mercury, waxing Moon) are placed in the angular houses (1st, 4th, 7th, 10th).

Effect: A Raja yoga is formed.

condition.yoga_name: Atmakaraka in Benefic Rasi — Wealth Yoga

yoga_check.description: Requires identifying Atmakaraka (highest-degree planet) — Jaimini concept. Navamsa check additionally requires D-9 chart.

interpretation.brief: The native will be wealthy.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: The Atmakaraka planet is placed in a sign owned by a natural benefic (Jupiter, Venus, Mercury, Moon) or in a benefic's Navamsa sign.

Effect: The native will be wealthy.

condition.yoga_name: Benefics in Angles from Karakamsa Lagna — Raja Yoga

yoga_check.description: Angular houses are counted from Karakamsa Lagna, not natal Lagna. Karakamsa requires Atmakaraka identification + D-9 computation — both outside current engine scope.

interpretation.brief: The native will become a king.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: Natural benefics are placed in the angular houses (kendras) counted from the Karakamsa Lagna (Navamsa sign of the Atmakaraka).

Effect: The native will become a king.

condition.yoga_name: Arudha Lagna and Darapada — Raja Yoga

yoga_check.description: Arudha Lagna and Darapada are Jaimini Pada (image) concepts derived via a specific counting algorithm from the 1st and 7th house lords. Outside current engine scope.

interpretation.brief: The native will doubtlessly become a king.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: The Arudha Lagna (Pada of the 1st house) and Darapada (Pada of the 7th house) are in mutual angular positions (1-4-7-10 from each other), mutual trinal positions (1-5-9), or in mutual 3rd/11th relationship.

Effect: The native will doubtlessly become a king.

condition.yoga_name: Arudha-Darapada Adverse — Poverty

yoga_check.description: Adverse form of Arudha-Darapada yoga — mutual 6/8 or 2/12 positions destroy Raja Yoga maturity. Requires Jaimini Pada derivation for both Arudha Lagna and Darapada.

interpretation.brief: The native will suffer from poverty and will not receive the beneficial effects of any Raja Yogas in the horoscope. The
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: The Arudha Lagna and Darapada are in mutual 6th/8th signs or mutual 2nd/12th signs.

Effect: The native will suffer from poverty and will not receive the beneficial effects of any Raja Yogas in the horoscope. The good relationship between Arudha Pada and Dara Pada is an essential prerequisite for maturity of Raja Yogas.

condition.yoga_name: Arudha Pada with Exalted Planet — Raja Yoga (A)

yoga_check.description: Arudha Pada requires Jaimini Pada derivation. Exaltation (dignity) check and Argala (intervention analysis) also required.

interpretation.brief: The native will become a king.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: The Arudha Pada (Arudha Lagna) is occupied by an exalted planet — especially the Moon in exaltation (Taurus) or by Jupiter or Venus (with or without exaltation) — and there is no Argala (intervention) by a natural malefic planet.

Effect: The native will become a king.

condition.yoga_name: Arudha Pada with Moon in Benefic Sign — Raja Yoga (B)

yoga_check.description: Arudha Pada requires Jaimini Pada derivation. Benefic sign classification (sign owned by benefic planet) is a dignity check. Jupiter in house 2 from natal Lagna is checkable alone but the combined condition requires Arudha Pada.

interpretation.brief: The native will become a king.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: The Arudha Pada is a benefic sign (sign owned by Jupiter, Venus, Mercury, or Moon) AND the Moon occupies the Arudha Pada AND Jupiter is in the 2nd house from the natal ascendant.

Effect: The native will become a king.

condition.yoga_name: Dusthana Lord Debilitated Aspects Lagna — Raja Yoga

yoga_check.description: Requires identifying lords of houses 6, 8, and 12 and checking their debilitation sign + aspect to Lagna.

interpretation.brief: A Raja yoga is formed.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: Even if one among the lords of the 6th, 8th, and 12th houses is in debilitation (neecha) and aspects the natal ascendant, a Raja yoga is formed.

Effect: A Raja yoga is formed.

condition.yoga_name: Kendra-Trikona Lord Aspects Lagna with Venus and Arudha — Raja Yoga

yoga_check.description: Triple condition: lord of 4/10/2/11 identification, Arudha Lagna derivation (Jaimini), and aspect checks on Lagna and Arudha Lagna 11th position.

interpretation.brief: The native will become a king.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: A planet ruling the 4th, 10th, 2nd, or 11th house aspects the natal ascendant, while Venus aspects the 11th house from the Arudha Lagna AND the Arudha Lagna itself is occupied by a natural benefic.

Effect: The native will become a king.

condition.yoga_name: Debilitated Planet in 6th-8th Aspects Lagna — Raja Yoga

yoga_check.description: Requires checking debilitation (neecha) sign for any planet in house 6 or 8 — dignity check. Aspect to Lagna also required.

interpretation.brief: The native will become a king.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: A debilitated (neecha) planet placed in the 6th or 8th house aspects the natal ascendant.

Effect: The native will become a king.

condition.yoga_name: Debilitated Planet in 3rd-11th Aspects Lagna — Raja Yoga

yoga_check.description: Requires checking debilitation sign for any planet in house 3 or 11 + aspect to Lagna. Neecha determination requires knowing each planet's debilitation sign.

interpretation.brief: The native will become a king.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: A debilitated (neecha) planet placed in the 3rd or 11th house aspects the natal ascendant.

Effect: The native will become a king.

condition.yoga_name: 5th and 9th Lord Mutual Aspect or Conjunction — Raja Yoga

yoga_check.description: Requires identifying 5th lord and 9th lord. Mutual aspect and mutual 7th position checks also needed.

interpretation.brief: The native will obtain a kingdom.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: The 9th lord (equated to a minister) and the 5th lord (equated to the chief minister) mutually aspect each other, or are conjunct in any house, or are in mutual 7th positions. For a person of royal lineage, this combination gives the kingdom.

Effect: The native will obtain a kingdom.

condition.yoga_name: 4th-10th Parivartana with 5th-9th Aspect — Raja Yoga

yoga_check.description: Requires identifying lords of houses 4, 5, 9, 10. Four separate lord lookups + sign exchange verification + aspect detection.

interpretation.brief: The native will attain kingdom.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: The 4th lord is placed in the 10th house AND the 10th lord is placed in the 4th house (a Parivartana / sign-exchange between houses 4 and 10) and both are aspected by the 5th and 9th lords.

Effect: The native will attain kingdom.

condition.yoga_name: Lords of 5-10-4-Asc All in 9th — Raja Yoga

yoga_check.description: Requires identifying lords of houses 1, 4, 5, and 10 — four lord lookups — and verifying all are in house 9.

interpretation.brief: The native will become a ruler with fame spreading over the four directions.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: The lords of the 5th, 10th, 4th, and ascendant are all conjunct in the 9th house.

Effect: The native will become a ruler with fame spreading over the four directions.

condition.yoga_name: 4th Lord Joins 5th Lord — Raja Yoga

yoga_check.description: Requires identifying 4th lord and 5th lord.

interpretation.brief: The native will obtain kingdom.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: The lord of the 4th house is conjunct with the lord of the 5th house (angular lord joins trinal lord). Per the text: 'It will be still superior if the 4th lord joins both the 5th and 9th lords.'

Effect: The native will obtain kingdom.

condition.yoga_name: 4th Lord Joins 9th Lord — Raja Yoga

yoga_check.description: Requires identifying 4th lord and 9th lord.

interpretation.brief: The native will obtain kingdom.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: The lord of the 4th house is conjunct with the lord of the 9th house (angular lord joins trinal lord).

Effect: The native will obtain kingdom.

condition.yoga_name: 10th Lord Joins 9th Lord — Raja Yoga

yoga_check.description: Requires identifying 10th lord and 9th lord.

interpretation.brief: The native will obtain kingdom.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: The lord of the 10th house is conjunct with the lord of the 9th house (angular lord joins trinal lord).

Effect: The native will obtain kingdom.

condition.yoga_name: 10th Lord Joins 5th Lord — Raja Yoga

yoga_check.description: Requires identifying 10th lord and 5th lord.

interpretation.brief: The native will obtain kingdom.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: The lord of the 10th house is conjunct with the lord of the 5th house (angular lord joins trinal lord).

Effect: The native will obtain kingdom.

condition.yoga_name: 5th Lord in Kendra with 9th or Asc Lord — Raja Yoga

yoga_check.description: Requires identifying lords of houses 1, 5, 9 and verifying 5th lord's house position.

interpretation.brief: The native will become a king.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: The lord of the 5th house is placed in the ascendant (1st), 4th, or 10th house AND is in conjunction with either the 9th lord or the ascendant lord.

Effect: The native will become a king.

condition.yoga_name: Jupiter in Own Sign in 9th with Venus or 5th Lord — Raja Yoga

yoga_check.description: Jupiter's own sign in 9th house requires knowing which sign occupies house 9 for the given ascendant (dignity check). 5th lord identification also required.

interpretation.brief: The native will obtain kinghood.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: Jupiter is placed in the 9th house in his own sign (Sagittarius or Pisces must be the 9th house for the given ascendant) AND is in conjunction with either Venus or the lord of the 5th house.

Effect: The native will obtain kinghood.

condition.yoga_name: Birth Near Dinardha / Nisardha — Raja Yoga

yoga_check.description: Birth-time check, not a chart position check. Requires birth time, sunrise, sunset at birth location to compute Dinardha and Nisardha, then measure time difference. Cannot be determined from Rasi chart planetary positions alone.

interpretation.brief: The native will be a king or equal to a king.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: Birth occurs within two-and-a-half ghatis (60 minutes by Parasara; 48 minutes per Uttara Kalamrita) of Dinardha (the middle of the day — half the daylight duration from sunrise) or Nisardha (the middle of the night — half the night duration from sunset). Note: Dinardha is NOT fixed 12 Noon but the actual midpoint of daylight hours at the given location.

Effect: The native will be a king or equal to a king.

condition.yoga_name: Koteeswara Yoga

yoga_check.description: Both conditions require exaltation (dignity) check — which planet in house 2 is exalted, and which aspecting planet is also exalted. Aspect detection also required.

interpretation.brief: A Koteeswara (multi-millionaire / crorepati) is born.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: An exalted planet is placed in the 2nd house AND is aspected by another exalted planet (from Uttara Kalamrita tradition).

Effect: A Koteeswara (multi-millionaire / crorepati) is born.

condition.yoga_name: Lakshadheew Yoga

yoga_check.description: Exaltation check for planet in house 2 + own-sign check for aspecting planet (dignity checks) + aspect detection required.

interpretation.brief: The native will be a Lakshadhipati (lakhs-owner) — highly wealthy but with relatively less riches than Koteeswara.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: An exalted planet is placed in the 2nd house AND is aspected by a planet in its own sign (not exaltation — lesser form of Koteeswara Yoga).

Effect: The native will be a Lakshadhipati (lakhs-owner) — highly wealthy but with relatively less riches than Koteeswara.

condition.yoga_name: Moon and Venus in Mutual 3rd-11th — Raja Yoga

yoga_check.description: Requires computing the relative house distance between Moon and Venus — not a check from the Lagna. Phase 2: implement as new type 'mutual_house_distance' with planets=[Moon, Venus] and distances=[3, 11].

interpretation.brief: A Raja yoga is obtained.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: The Moon and Venus are placed in mutual 3rd and 11th positions from each other — one is in the 3rd sign from the other (and therefore the other is simultaneously in the 11th from the first).

Effect: A Raja yoga is obtained.

condition.yoga_name: Moon and Venus Mutually Aspecting — Raja Yoga

yoga_check.description: Mutual aspect detection between Moon and Venus. Mutual 7th aspect (opposition) is the primary form. Aspect checks are outside current Rasi position-only engine scope.

interpretation.brief: A Raja yoga is obtained.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: The Moon and Venus are placed in any houses but aspect each other mutually (either by 7th-house opposition aspect or by special aspects if applicable).

Effect: A Raja yoga is obtained.

condition.yoga_name: Moon in Vargothamsa with 4+ Aspects — Raja Yoga

yoga_check.description: Vargothamsa requires comparing Moon's sign in D-1 and D-9 charts — D-9 computation required. Counting aspects from 4+ planets also requires aspect detection.

interpretation.brief: The native will become a king.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: The Moon is in Vargothamsa (same sign in the Rasi chart D-1 and the Navamsa chart D-9, indicating it is in the same Navamsa as its Rasi sign) AND is aspected by four or more planets.

Effect: The native will become a king.

condition.yoga_name: Ascendant in Uttamamsa with 4+ Aspects — Raja Yoga

yoga_check.description: Uttamamsa requires computing all 6 Shadvarga divisional charts and evaluating cumulative dignity score of the ascendant. Aspect count (excluding Moon) also requires aspect detection.

interpretation.brief: The native will become a king.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: The natal ascendant is in Uttamamsa (highest dignity classification in the Shadvarga / six-divisional scheme) AND is aspected by four or more planets, among which the Moon should NOT be one.

Effect: The native will become a king.

condition.yoga_name: 1 Planet Exalted — Raja Yoga (Partial)

yoga_check.description: Requires checking each planet's sign against its exaltation sign (Sun=Aries, Moon=Taurus, Mars=Capricorn, Mercury=Virgo, Jupiter=Cancer, Venus=Pisces, Saturn=Libra). Dignity check not yet in current engine. Phase 2: new type 'planets_in_dignity_count' with dignity='exaltation', count=1.

interpretation.brief: A person of royal lineage will become a king. This is the lowest tier of the exaltation-count Raja Yoga series.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: One planet is in its exaltation sign.

Effect: A person of royal lineage will become a king. This is the lowest tier of the exaltation-count Raja Yoga series.

condition.yoga_name: 2 Planets Exalted — Raja Yoga (Medium)

yoga_check.description: Count of exalted planets = 2. Phase 2: 'planets_in_dignity_count' with dignity='exaltation', count=2.

interpretation.brief: The native will be equal to a king.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: Two planets are in their respective exaltation signs.

Effect: The native will be equal to a king.

condition.yoga_name: 3 Planets Exalted — Wealth Yoga

yoga_check.description: Count of exalted planets = 3. Phase 2: 'planets_in_dignity_count' with dignity='exaltation', count=3.

interpretation.brief: The native will be wealthy.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: Three planets are in their respective exaltation signs.

Effect: The native will be wealthy.

condition.yoga_name: 4-5 Planets Exalted or Moolatrikona — Raja Yoga

yoga_check.description: Count of planets in exaltation or Moolatrikona = 4 or 5. Phase 2: 'planets_in_dignity_count' with dignity=['exaltation','moolatrikona'], min_count=4, max_count=5.

interpretation.brief: Even a person of base birth will become a king.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: Four or five planets are in their exaltation signs or Moolatrikona signs.

Effect: Even a person of base birth will become a king.

condition.yoga_name: 6 Planets Exalted — Emperor Yoga

yoga_check.description: Count of exalted planets = 6. Phase 2: 'planets_in_dignity_count' with dignity='exaltation', count=6.

interpretation.brief: The native will become emperor and will enjoy various royal paraphernalia.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: Six planets are in their exaltation signs.

Effect: The native will become emperor and will enjoy various royal paraphernalia.

condition.yoga_name: Jupiter-Venus-Mercury Exalted with Benefic in Angle — Raja Yoga

yoga_check.description: The exaltation condition (Jupiter exalted in Cancer, Venus in Pisces, Mercury in Virgo) requires dignity check. The benefic-in-angle part alone is checkable but the combined rule requires dignity. Phase 2: compound type with dignity check + benefics_in_houses.

interpretation.brief: The native will become a king or be equal to a king.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: At least one among Jupiter, Venus, and Mercury is in its exaltation sign AND a natural benefic is placed in an angular house (1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th).

Effect: The native will become a king or be equal to a king.

condition.yoga_name: All Benefics in Angles, Malefics in 3-6-11 — Raja Yoga

yoga_check.description: Benefics in angular houses {1,4,7,10} AND malefics in upachaya houses {3,6,11}. All conditions purely positional — no lord or dignity lookup required.

interpretation.brief: The native, though of mean descent, will ascend the throne.
interpretation.detailed:
Formation: All natural benefics are relegated to angular houses (1st, 4th, 7th, 10th) while natural malefics are placed in the 3rd, 6th, and 11th houses (Upachaya houses).

Effect: The native, though of mean descent, will ascend the throne.
